name: OpenFolder Links
description: Turns UNC paths (\\server\share\...) on allowed file servers into clickable openfolder: links that open the folder in Windows Explorer. The path stays visible and copyable.

settings_schema.header: UNC paths on the servers below are converted into links when a message is posted. Clients need the openfolder: protocol handler installed (see client/windows in the repository).

settings.help_text: Host names, separated by commas. Leave empty to disable the plugin. Keep this list in sync with allowed-servers.txt on the Windows clients.
